tests.description: Where the key lives and what runs without it, over committed fixtures and with no key ever written.

steps.description: `key set --dry-run` reports the write it would make and writes nothing.
The same run warns on stderr that the config it would write is not ignored by git.

runShell.stdio: manni.config.yaml is not ignored by git

steps.description: `key rotate` with no key available refuses, exit 2, and names `key set`.

runShell.stdio: No encryption key is available, so nothing can be re-encrypted. Run `manni key set` first.

steps.description: A key shorter than 32 characters is refused and never written.

runShell.stdio: The key must be at least 32 hex or base64url characters.

steps.description: With no key, validate warns once on stderr with the count of values it could not verify.

runShell.stdio: 3 encrypted values were not verified: no encryption key is available.

steps.description: The findings under those values are dropped, so the same run passes every page and exits 0.
With no key, an encrypted citation source is source-missing and the check fails.

runShell.stdio: missing (no encryption key is available to decrypt it)

steps.description: --no-check-sources reports the same encrypted source as skipped and passes.

runShell.stdio: /:2 skipped[\s\S]*1 file checked, 1 passed, 0 failed, 0 findings/
